annotations.title: Two clubs side by side before they meet

description: Form Guide. Two clubs side by side before they meet. For requests like "Arsenal v Leeds, how do they compare?". Gives positions, form, goals, this season's meeting and the next date they play. Stats only, not betting advice.

country.description: US or CA adds US Eastern kick-off times to the say line (and to each fixture's us_eastern, which is always there when a time is known).

home.description: The home club, for example Arsenal.

team1.description: Older name for home, kept for existing callers; home is the current name.

team2.description: Older name for away, kept for existing callers; away is the current name.
